verdict.rationale: Spline's states/events/actions system, webhooks, and Real-time API let users define rules that trigger actions automatically on events (e.g., 'automatically trigger actions, update variables, and react to data sent from external sources'), which is core automation-depth functionality. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of event-rule automation in practice, and more detail on the breadth/complexity of conditional logic supported beyond docs claims.
